perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.desc: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Stunning Recovery
perks.desc: Stunning a Champion refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and improves recovery for a short duration.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

perks.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
perks.desc: This weapon has increased reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 139 from 13 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0m6Sfdv88fNZmYm9A6PdVR?si=140d643338154357) with @ImpetusAlways @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with an arc build. Cruel Mercy is the new Heresy Act 3 Nightfall weapon - the Heavy Burst intrinsic gives you a bit of flinch reduction when ADSing, which is useful if unspectacular. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 76 Range equates to 39.06m ADS and 21.70m hipfire before damage dropoff, 35 Stability is ×1.1337 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 35 Handling is 0.45s ready, 0.40s ADS and 0.44s stow speed, 42 Reload Speed is a 2.01s reload, Recoil Direction is 74, and Zoom is 18. Handling is the main weakness, so look to improve that from the barrel perk to make things snappier. For the magazine perk, either choose your preferred combat effect or look to speed up the reload a bit. For arc builds there's a combination of Eddy Current to speed up reload further, together with Rolling Storm to build up stacks of Bolt Charge for single target damage plus a bit of AoE. But, as an alternative first trait column perk, Dragonfly provides an AoE arc elemental explosion on a crit kill for double damage perks, which are always tough to pass on. For the origin trait you have Vanguard's Vindication for 3HP healing per kill, Stunning Recovery for 60HP and +40 recovery for 3s when stunning a champion, or Omolon Fluid Dynamics for better stability and reload speed in the top half of the magazine for compulsive reloaders. Recommended MW: Handling, with an Adept Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Ionic Traces or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "To answer people's primary question, "is this better than Corrasion?": very slightly at base and definitely with an adept version. The only thing that Cruel Mercy doesn't win is the origin trait, but Omolon Fluid Dynamics is still solid enough. For PvE, the perks are decent, giving you some different options based your build. As with other Heavy Bursts, you'll want to improve any of the non-Range stats, especially Stability and Reload." Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "In the Crucible, Cruel Mercy is probably better equipped than its other energy-slot relatives. Take its Origin Trait, Omolon Fluid Dynamics, and combine it with the strength of Keep Away or Lone Wolf. Add in your TTK reducing perk of choice and the combination makes for a potent package! Like other Heavy Burst weapons, this gun does suffer from feeling a bit clunky, so invest in Stability and Handling as you see fit." Recommended MW: Stability or Handling
